input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 reads as an auto-renewal/non-renewal mechanic rather than an express convenience exit for us, and it lets HDI's notice fix any termination date, so HDI effectively holds a mid-term walk-away; Section 4.2(a) then charges us an uncapped early-termination fee (half of twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000), far above three months of fees. That fails the fallback on three elements. We target the fallback: an express Company convenience right on ninety (90) days' notice effective on the date specified in our notice, HDI's termination effective only at the end of the then-current term, and the Termination Payment capped at three months of Section 3 fees (the existing formula, zero floor and instalment schedule are retained). HDI's 90-day notice obligation is already met by the retained mutual notice sentence. Note the cap measures against the Section 3 revenue-share fees; if HDI resists, we can express it as three months' average Section 3 payments.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
Vendor may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term.
Vendor must give at least 90 days' notice of convenience termination.
mappings.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other

proposal.summary: Add an express Company convenience termination right on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made our exit explicit — the Company may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice effective on the date specified in its notice — and limited HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term. We have also capped the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, but in no event more than three (3) months of fees payable under Section 3.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon ninety (90) days' written notice to HDI, effective on the date specified in that notice. Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term.
